# Differential Geometry

This course introduces the central geometric ideas behind smooth manifolds and the linear spaces attached to them.

## Course goals

- Develop intuition for spaces that locally resemble Euclidean space.
- Understand tangent and cotangent spaces.
- Connect local calculus to global geometric structure.

## Recommended path

1. Start with manifolds.
2. Study tangent spaces.
3. Finish with cotangent spaces.
